name: @runsecure/hkdfguard-pipeline-googlesecretmanager
description: HkdfGuard secret pipeline writer over Google Cloud Secret Manager (Google Cloud client library for Node.js): pulls a fixed list of secrets, taken out of the response before the client can make them messages, encrypts each at once with a PipelineDataProtector bound to its file name, and writes one file per secret for FilePerSecretCache.
